role: Business Intelligence Developer (Strong in Tableau / Snowflake / SQL)
responsibilities: Drive business requirements gathering and analysis, engaging stakeholders to understand business needs, challenge unclear requirements and translate business problems into clear functional specifications, business rules, KPIs and acceptance criteria.

Independently design and develop Tableau dashboards, translating business requirements into effective visualisations, interactive dashboards and analytical views that provide meaningful business insights.

Translate business questions into analytical requirements, defining appropriate metrics, dimensions, calculations, filters and drill-down capabilities to ensure dashboards address the underlying business needs.
Work closely with stakeholders to refine dashboard design and usability, ensuring visualisations are intuitive, relevant and aligned with business expectations.
Perform data analysis to identify trends, anomalies and key drivers, supporting business users in investigating issues and deriving insights from data.
Use SQL to extract, analyse and validate data, supporting dashboard development, data reconciliation and investigation of discrepancies.
Investigate reporting and data issues, working with relevant stakeholders and technical teams to identify root causes and implement appropriate solutions.
Work with data and technology teams to clarify data requirements, validate business logic and ensure dashboards and analytical outputs accurately reflect agreed requirements.
Coordinate delivery activities, including requirements tracking, prioritisation, UAT, issue follow-up and implementation.
Identify opportunities to enhance existing dashboards, improve reporting processes and reduce manual effort through better visualisation and analytics.

evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: Use SQL to extract, analyse and validate data, supporting dashboard development, data reconciliation and investigation of discrepancies.
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Rigour: the duties repeat validation, reconciliation, UAT and dashboards that 'accurately reflect agreed requirements', with no speed language.
evidence.domain_risk: Familiarity with investment data, portfolio reporting, performance monitoring or financial metrics.
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: High: the client is a Singapore sovereign fund, and the posting names portfolio reporting, financial metrics and reconciliation of reported figures.
evidence.data_team_maturity: This role sits within a small team (~5) supporting business stakeholders within a Singapore sovereign fund.
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: Mid: an existing team of about five maintains dashboards the role will 'enhance', on a SQL platform such as Snowflake.
evidence.jd_authorship: defining appropriate metrics, dimensions, calculations, filters and drill-down capabilities
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Mixed: some duties are specific to Tableau and UAT delivery, while others are generic stakeholder-engagement boilerplate.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: supporting business stakeholders within a Singapore sovereign fund
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: Finance: the audience is investment business users at a sovereign fund, with portfolio reporting and financial metrics as the subject matter.
evidence.autonomy_level: Drive business requirements gathering and analysis
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: Mixed: the role drives requirements and independently designs dashboards, while supporting business users and coordinating delivery.
evidence.ai_role_explanation: No AI tool use or AI data work is expected of the candidate.
evidence.testing_framing: Use SQL to extract, analyse and validate data
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Responsibility: validating data, reconciliation and UAT are listed duties rather than tools in a skills list.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing: ensure dashboards and analytical outputs accurately reflect agreed requirements
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: Moderate: accuracy of reported figures is a recurring concern, but the posting is framed mainly around dashboard delivery.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: Identify opportunities to enhance existing dashboards, improve reporting processes
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: Mixed: the role both builds new Tableau dashboards and enhances existing ones.
